description: Jurisdiction catalog. Enumerates every surface the register must account for: US federal, all 50 states plus DC, an aggregate multistate marker, Canada, and Mexico. coverage records honesty about each jurisdiction: confirmed = it has its own obligation rows; tracked = it is watched only through an aggregate multistate row; aggregate = the multistate marker itself.
